sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राम सुमाली नाम राक्षसः ।नानाप्रहरणैः क्रुद्धस्तत्सैन्यं सो ऽभ्यवर्तत ।। ७.२७.३९ ॥
transliteration: etasminnantare rāma sumālī nāma rākṣasaḥ ।nānāpraharaṇaiḥ kruddhastatsainyaṁ so 'bhyavartata ।। 7.27.39 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, in the meantime, a demon named Sumali, enraged and wielding various weapons, attacked that army.
